answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 43399 Country: India Title: Dream of menstruation Question: My wife had a dream of her own menstruation and saw the bedspread wet with blood. Can you please tell the interpretation of this dream? Answer ID: 43399 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 212/161/B=1434) Ask your wife to maintain purity and keep her clothes neat and clean as well as offer salah regularly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
